industry.structure: U.S. healthcare real estate is fragmented across outpatient medical, life-science lab, and senior housing operators; large listed REITs compete on cost of capital, cluster concentration, and tenant relationships. Triple-net leases dominate outpatient and lab assets.
industry.share_shift: Healthpeak gained scale via the Physicians Realty merger and lab acquisitions (e.g., Gateway Crossing JV 2025), while shedding or spinning senior housing through the planned Janus Living vehicle.
industry.trend: Higher rates pressure levered REIT spreads; lab demand is cyclical with biotech funding; senior housing benefits from aging demographics but faces labor and regulatory cost pressure.
